literal_meaning: একবার মাটির প্রলেপ দেওয়া হয়েছে এমন
figurative_meaning_en: done in a superficial or hasty manner
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই দেয়ালটা একমেটে মেরে দেওয়া হয়েছে, তাই ফাটল ধরেছে।
তার লেখাটা একমেটে লেখা, বিস্তারিত নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: This wall was plastered in one hasty coat, so it's cracking.
His writing is superficial, done in a slapdash way.
history: Originates from traditional Bengali rural construction practices where mud plastering (mete) is applied in multiple layers for durability; a single layer indicates poor or rushed work.
note: The idiom draws from pre-modern building techniques common in Bengali villages.
